Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
Koh Tao Travel Guide (Pt 1) | Where to Stay & Solo Travel Tips
TOP 5 THINGS TO DO in KOH TAO
Why Everyone Loves Koh Tao 🇹🇭 (Copy Our Itinerary – 6 Trips Later)

spots.name: Koh Nang Yuan
spots.description: A stunning small island just off Koh Tao accessible only by boat taxi, famous for its Maldives-like crystal-clear waters, large round boulders, and two unique sandbanks connecting the islands. Has a popular viewpoint that draws significant queues. The creator called it the most beautiful place they had ever visited.

mentions.videoTitle: Is KOH TAO, THAILAND Still Worth Traveling to?
mentions.quote: The water is like Maldives, but with this big round rocks. It's so unique and so beautiful.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao BLEW My Mind! Best Beaches, Epic Food & Hidden Gems
mentions.quote: It is absolutely beautiful—three islands that are connected by these beautiful white sandbars.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: This is the most famous and the most beautiful spot near Koh Tao.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao Travel Guide (Pt 1) | Where to Stay & Solo Travel Tips
mentions.quote: There's literally no one here — it was such a cool private experience.

mentions.videoTitle: TOP 5 THINGS TO DO in KOH TAO
mentions.quote: nanguan island is a collection of three islands which are connected by this sandbank and it is absolutely stunning

mentions.videoTitle: Why Everyone Loves Koh Tao 🇹🇭 (Copy Our Itinerary – 6 Trips Later)
mentions.quote: The first stop on our trip is Nang Yuan Island which is a very protected area in Thailand for marine life – it is stunning.

thingsToKnow: Boat taxi is required as there is no driving access to the island.
The viewpoint had a 30-minute queue.
From Koh Phangan the boat costs around $17 and takes about 1.5 hours.
Gets busy in the main area but quieter spots exist if you explore.
Boat ride from Sairee Beach takes about 10 minutes and costs 300 baht round-trip.
Entrance ticket costs an additional 250 baht.
The sandbars can only be walked on at low tide—plan your visit accordingly.
Gets very busy with tourists.

spots.name: Blacktip Connect
spots.description: A co-working and wellness space on Koh Tao with AC, comfortable chairs, a small sauna, ice bath, an outdoor calisthenic workout area, and a café serving coconuts and smoothie bowls. Available as a 500 THB day pass.

mentions.videoTitle: Is KOH TAO, THAILAND Still Worth Traveling to?
mentions.quote: It's 500 B for day pass for the co-working and the sauna and ice bath.

thingsToKnow: Day pass is 500 baht and includes co-working, sauna, and ice bath.
Wi-Fi upload is decent but download speed is not very fast.
Ice bath and sauna slots require booking in advance as they are available only on certain days and times.

spots.name: Sairee Beach
spots.description: Sairee Beach is the main beach and hub of Koh Tao, recommended as the best area to base yourself. The creator stayed here for their second week and loved being able to walk to all shops, restaurants, and dive/excursion bookings without needing a scooter. They also witnessed what they called the best sunset of their lives right from this beach.

mentions.videoTitle: ULTIMATE GUIDE TO KOH TAO 2024 (Where to Stay, Where to Eat, Things to do and Much More!)
mentions.quote: The most successful place to stay is Mae Haad Pier or Sairee Beach — we've been able to walk everywhere which has been great.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao BLEW My Mind! Best Beaches, Epic Food & Hidden Gems
mentions.quote: This is definitely the best place to watch [the sunset], and I've been here every night to see it.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao Thailand 🇹🇭 | A Real Day in Island Life, Beaches, Food & Tips
mentions.quote: This beach is the kind of spot where you show up for an hour and somehow the whole afternoon passes and you're like, I could be here even longer.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: This is the most popular and the biggest beach on the island.

mentions.videoTitle: TOP 5 THINGS TO DO in KOH TAO
mentions.quote: sari Beach this is a long stretch of the main town/city the touristy area it's just a really long stretch of beach

mentions.videoTitle: Why Everyone Loves Koh Tao 🇹🇭 (Copy Our Itinerary – 6 Trips Later)
mentions.quote: Why order a cup of beer when you can get 3 litres at the sunset on Sairee Beach in Koh Tao – it's 650 baht.

thingsToKnow: Staying on Sairee Beach lets you walk to most amenities and reduces the need for a scooter or expensive taxis.
Ratings on Booking.com for hotels here can appear misleadingly low — the creator suggests visiting in person as properties often look fine.
Some beaches on Koh Tao charge an entry fee, so carry cash when visiting beaches.
The beach area can flood when it rains, so be prepared to walk barefoot.
Mornings are calm and relaxed; afternoons get very busy with volleyball, frisbee, bars, and restaurants.
Best spot on the island to watch the sunset.
Sea lice (tiny invisible jellyfish) are present in the water and can give small stings.
A special sunscreen is sold locally that repels sea lice — worth buying especially if you are allergic.

spots.name: The Factory
spots.description: The Factory is one of the creator's favourite spots on Koh Tao, a cafe-style eatery near Sairee Beach. They enjoyed chocolate chip pancakes and a chocolate brownie shake there and praised the variety and quality of food on the island.

mentions.videoTitle: ULTIMATE GUIDE TO KOH TAO 2024 (Where to Stay, Where to Eat, Things to do and Much More!)
mentions.quote: We are currently sat in The Factory which is one of our favourite places here in Koh Tao.

spots.name: KoHub
spots.description: KoHub is a co-working space on Koh Tao offering 24/7 access with reliably strong Wi-Fi and air conditioning — a rarity on the island where power cuts can knock out connectivity. The creator found it the best option for remote work on Koh Tao and noted the owner also rents scooters at below-market rates.

mentions.videoTitle: ULTIMATE GUIDE TO KOH TAO 2024 (Where to Stay, Where to Eat, Things to do and Much More!)
mentions.quote: I found this co-working space called KoHub — 24/7 access is 400 baht for a day and 1,500 baht for a week, really really strong Wi-Fi and they have air conditioning.

thingsToKnow: 24/7 access costs 400 baht per day or 1,500 baht per week.
The owner rents 160cc scooters for 200 baht per day, well below the island average of 300–350 baht.
Has strong Wi-Fi and air conditioning, making it more reliable than cafes when the island generators cut out.

spots.name: Coral Grand Resort
spots.description: A beachfront resort on Sairee Beach with bungalows by the sea, a swimming pool, and a dive shop on site. The creator stayed here for its direct access to the main beach in town.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao BLEW My Mind! Best Beaches, Epic Food & Hidden Gems
mentions.quote: They have bungalows by the sea with decent rooms, a nice swimming pool, dive shop on site, and direct access to the main beach in town.

thingsToKnow: Has a dive shop on site for convenient access to diving.

spots.name: Lotus Bar
spots.description: A bar on Sairee Beach that hosts a nightly fire show at around 8:00 PM between two dramatically angled palm trees out front. The creator was really impressed and says it is pretty amazing.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao BLEW My Mind! Best Beaches, Epic Food & Hidden Gems
mentions.quote: Around 8:00 at the Lotus Bar, they have these two palm trees out front... you can go and watch a fire show, and let me tell you—it is pretty amazing.

mentions.videoTitle: TOP 5 THINGS TO DO in KOH TAO
mentions.quote: there is a fire show which is at Lotus bar which was unfortunately cancelled

thingsToKnow: Fire show starts at around 8:00 PM.
Conveniently located right before the main town nightlife strip—easy to walk there afterward.
Fire shows can be cancelled depending on conditions — check ahead before going specifically for the show.

spots.name: Ao Leuk
spots.description: The creator's favorite snorkeling spot on Koh Tao, where lucky visitors can spot baby blacktip reef sharks. Considered far superior to the snorkeling at Koh Nang Yuan.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao BLEW My Mind! Best Beaches, Epic Food & Hidden Gems
mentions.quote: My favorite spot is Ao Leuk, where if you're lucky, you can see baby sharks.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: Aow Leuk is a nice snorkeling spot.

mentions.videoTitle: TOP 5 THINGS TO DO in KOH TAO
mentions.quote: for me this was the most amazing place because it was crystal clear water we saw parrot fish zebra fish uh sardines just so many different fish the coral was multicolored and it was just beautiful

thingsToKnow: Creator's top-rated snorkeling spot on the island.
Baby sharks can sometimes be spotted, but sightings depend on luck.
Some beaches on Koh Tao charge an entrance fee collected by the hotel; they typically provide a soft drink and access to chairs and bathrooms.
The second snorkeling area is marked with a rope on the far right side of the beach and requires swimming a fair distance to reach.
This is a stop on the organized full-day snorkeling trip; jumping off the boat gets you closer to the snorkeling area than swimming from the beach.

spots.name: Big Blue Divers
spots.description: A well-regarded dive operator on Koh Tao with highly competitive prices and comfortable boats accessing excellent local dive sites. The creator praised it as some of the best dive pricing in the world and recommends getting certified here.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao BLEW My Mind! Best Beaches, Epic Food & Hidden Gems
mentions.quote: I went out with Big Blue Divers—their prices are great at only 600 to 800 baht per dive with equipment rental, which is some of the best pricing I've ever had in the world.

thingsToKnow: Dives cost 600–800 baht per dive including equipment rental.
Open water PADI certification available for as low as 8,500 baht.

spots.name: John-Suwan Viewpoint
spots.description: A breathtaking viewpoint at the southern tip of Koh Tao reached via a rocky trail hike. From the top you can see two vivid turquoise bays split by the island—a view the creator says will stick with them forever.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao BLEW My Mind! Best Beaches, Epic Food & Hidden Gems
mentions.quote: When you get there, you just emerge out into this breathtaking scene that made me think I was dreaming—two bays in front of you that are split by the island.

mentions.videoTitle: Why Everyone Loves Koh Tao 🇹🇭 (Copy Our Itinerary – 6 Trips Later)
mentions.quote: I'd recommend doing it on the first day of your trip when you haven't had too many beers and you can get up either early or come late in the day.

thingsToKnow: Requires hiking up a rocky trail to reach the top.
Located at the southern tip of the island.
Go early morning or late afternoon to avoid crowds and extreme heat.
Avoid going around 1:30pm when the car park is full and it is very busy.
Hike to the top takes roughly 10 minutes.

spots.name: Tanote Bay
spots.description: A wide, activity-filled beach on the east coast of Koh Tao with great snorkeling, beach games, and a bar. A large rock just offshore can be swum to, climbed with ropes, and jumped off for a thrill.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao BLEW My Mind! Best Beaches, Epic Food & Hidden Gems
mentions.quote: Just off the coast is a giant rock—you can swim out to it, climb up the outside with ropes, and then walk across the rock to the end and jump in.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: Tanote Bay is another wonderful little beach and a fun snorkeling spot.

mentions.videoTitle: Why Everyone Loves Koh Tao 🇹🇭 (Copy Our Itinerary – 6 Trips Later)
mentions.quote: We've headed to Tanote Bay, which is on the other side of the island, one of our favorite beaches for one specific reason – the rock you can swim out to and jump off.

thingsToKnow: The jump off the offshore rock is much higher than it looks—be mentally prepared.
Climbing the rock using the ropes is physically demanding.
The last stretch of the road going down to the bay is a bit steep, so be careful.
Google Maps may direct you to the wrong turning – check carefully before turning off the main road.
The road down to the bay is very steep.
There is very little shade on the beach and shaded spots fill up fast.
The sea is often significantly choppier here than on the west coast.
The offshore rock is quite far to swim, especially in choppy conditions, and the climb and jump are scarier than they look.

spots.name: Milk and Honey
spots.description: A restaurant on Koh Tao serving Mediterranean cuisine. The creator especially recommends stopping in for the hummus.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao BLEW My Mind! Best Beaches, Epic Food & Hidden Gems
mentions.quote: A great place to go and pick up some delicious Mediterranean food, especially the hummus.

spots.name: Choo Choo
spots.description: A Koh Tao restaurant serving Thai-Italian fusion food, most notably their signature curry pizzas. The creator found the unusual combination surprisingly and curiously delicious.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao BLEW My Mind! Best Beaches, Epic Food & Hidden Gems
mentions.quote: They actually make curry pizzas that are curiously delicious.

spots.name: Centrico
spots.description: A Mexican restaurant on Koh Tao serving authentic food and creative cocktails. The creator recommends the passion fruit margaritas.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao BLEW My Mind! Best Beaches, Epic Food & Hidden Gems
mentions.quote: A great place to go and pick up some authentic Mexicana food and have some passion fruit margaritas.

spots.name: The Treehouse Café
spots.description: A relaxed café on Koh Tao with a chilled-out atmosphere and delicious local Thai food. Perfect for a low-key meal away from the bustle.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao BLEW My Mind! Best Beaches, Epic Food & Hidden Gems
mentions.quote: Offers a really chilled-out vibe and some delicious local food.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: My favorite places are P.Oy's and the Tree House.

spots.name: Barracuda Restaurant
spots.description: A downtown Koh Tao restaurant with a beautiful upstairs dining area offering ocean views, live music, and a tasting menu blending Thai and international dishes. The creator highlights it as a top dining experience on the island.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao BLEW My Mind! Best Beaches, Epic Food & Hidden Gems
mentions.quote: They have a beautiful upstairs dining area that has the perfect view of the ocean during sunset, and they also have live music.

thingsToKnow: The upstairs dining area has ocean views—ideal timed for sunset.
Features live music alongside a Thai and international tasting menu.

spots.name: Pinnacle Resort
spots.description: A resort in the quieter southern part of Koh Tao with dramatic beachside bungalows built up a cliff face, an ocean-side pool, and sweeping sunset views. The creator recommends splitting your stay between here and Sairee Beach to experience two different sides of the island.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao BLEW My Mind! Best Beaches, Epic Food & Hidden Gems
mentions.quote: They have these beautiful beachside bungalows that go right up the cliff face, an amazing pool right on the ocean, friendly staff, restaurant, and the rooms are just beautiful with these views that just sweep across the ocean.

thingsToKnow: Located in the southern part of the island—a much quieter and different vibe compared to Sairee Beach.
Great for watching sunsets from the pool or room every evening.

spots.name: Sea Shell Resort
spots.description: The resort where the creator and her family stayed during their time on Koh Tao. It includes a free breakfast and is conveniently located right near Sairee Beach, the island's most popular beach.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao Thailand 🇹🇭 | A Real Day in Island Life, Beaches, Food & Tips
mentions.quote: We were staying at the Sea Shell Resort and we already had free breakfast.

thingsToKnow: Free breakfast is included with the stay.

spots.name: Koh Tao 7-Eleven Corner
spots.description: The iconic corner 7-Eleven on Koh Tao that serves as the unofficial social meeting spot of the island. Travelers gather here to grab drinks and snacks, bump into friends, and watch the nightly motorbike chaos and street life unfold.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao Thailand 🇹🇭 | A Real Day in Island Life, Beaches, Food & Tips
mentions.quote: It is the unofficial meeting spot on this island — flipflops parked out front, people grabbing drinks, snacks, and bumping into friends before heading off for the night.

spots.name: 995 Duck
spots.description: A famous and beloved restaurant on Koh Tao known for its roasted duck. The creator calls it the number-one must-visit on the island — generous portions, very affordable prices, casual atmosphere, and always busy.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao Thailand 🇹🇭 | A Real Day in Island Life, Beaches, Food & Tips
mentions.quote: If you are visiting the island, you have to put this place number one on your list — they are famous for their roasted duck.

thingsToKnow: Always busy — crowds are a sign of how good the food is.
Portions are very generous and prices are hard to beat.
Casual and quick dining experience.

spots.name: Dusit Buncha Resort
spots.description: A resort at the northern tip of Sairee Beach with a beautiful terrace overlooking Koh Nang Yuan. Hiking trails from here lead toward Cape Viewpoint through the jungle, though the creator advises against venturing into the jungle behind the hotel.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: The resort has a beautiful terrace overlooking Koh Nang Yuan.

thingsToKnow: The creator does not recommend venturing into the jungle behind the hotel.

spots.name: Mango Bay
spots.description: A great snorkeling spot at the north of Koh Tao, but very difficult to access by land due to a steep, rough dirt road that is not suitable for a scooter. The creator strongly recommends arriving by boat on an organized snorkeling trip instead.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: This is a great place for snorkeling, but the access by land is tricky — I would recommend coming here by boat.

thingsToKnow: Access by land requires a steep dirt road that is not suitable for a scooter.
Organized full-day snorkeling trips around the island include Mango Bay as a stop.

spots.name: Hin Wong Bay
spots.description: One of the creator's favorite beaches on Koh Tao — a small, secluded cove with gravel sand and a highly photogenic setting. It is an excellent snorkeling spot where fish come very close, with the best snorkeling around the rocks on both sides of the cove.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: The reason I like this little cove is that it feels very secluded — and it's so photogenic!

mentions.videoTitle: TOP 5 THINGS TO DO in KOH TAO
mentions.quote: hin Wong Bay which has a lovely snorkeling area as well and one that you absolutely must go to

mentions.videoTitle: Why Everyone Loves Koh Tao 🇹🇭 (Copy Our Itinerary – 6 Trips Later)
mentions.quote: It is a snorkeling spot, looks like a beautiful bay area and you can jump off the top.

thingsToKnow: The best snorkeling is around the rocks on both sides of the cove.
This is also a great diving spot.

spots.name: I Love Koh Tao Viewpoint
spots.description: A scenic viewpoint above Tanote Bay with a small café at the top offering a great panorama over the island. The road up from Tanote Bay is easy to drive on a scooter.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: You will find the 'I Love Koh Tao' viewpoint — at the end of it, there's a little cafe with a great panorama.

thingsToKnow: The road up to this viewpoint is easy to drive on a scooter.

spots.name: Coral Bay Resort
spots.description: A resort on the south coast of Koh Tao built dramatically down the cliffs, with two viewing platforms above that offer great views of Shark Island. The road leading to the resort is very photogenic. The last section of the road is very steep.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: The hotel itself is built down the cliffs — there are two viewing platforms above the hotel, this is a great lookout and photo stop.

thingsToKnow: The last bit of the road down to the resort is very steep.
Two viewing platforms above the hotel offer views of Shark Island and make a great photo stop.
Get your camera ready on the approach road — it is particularly photogenic.

spots.name: Sai Daeng Beach
spots.description: A visually pretty beach on the south coast of Koh Tao near the Coral Bay Resort. The creator found it attractive but did not swim or snorkel here, so its water quality is unknown.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: Sai Daeng Beach looks pretty, but we did not swim or snorkel here so I'm not sure if it's a good snorkeling spot.

spots.name: Shark Island
spots.description: A small island just off the south coast of Koh Tao that the creator confirms is a great snorkeling spot. It can be seen from the viewing platforms at the Coral Bay Resort.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: Shark Island, on the other hand, is definitely a great snorkeling spot.

mentions.videoTitle: Why Everyone Loves Koh Tao 🇹🇭 (Copy Our Itinerary – 6 Trips Later)
mentions.quote: We pulled into Shark Bay, hopped in the water, and bam, there she was – an absolute beauty.

thingsToKnow: Turtles are commonly spotted in the water here.

spots.name: Thian Og Bay
spots.description: Also known as Shark Bay, this is a larger beach on the south coast of Koh Tao. While there is a lot of dead coral in the water, it is one of the best spots on the island to see turtles and sharks, and is a stop on the full-day snorkeling trip.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: Thian Og Bay, also known as Shark Bay, is a great place to spot turtles and sharks.

mentions.videoTitle: TOP 5 THINGS TO DO in KOH TAO
mentions.quote: Shark Bay gets its name because it is known as the place in kotal you can actually see black tip reef sharks if you're lucky and also the sea turtles.

thingsToKnow: There is a lot of dead coral in the water here.
Day visitors must pay an entry fee to access the beach.
Paddle boards, kayaks, and snorkel gear available to hire from Haad Tien Resort.

spots.name: Chalok Bay
spots.description: A long, shallow bay and village on the south side of Koh Tao. The creator recommends it for grabbing food and cold drinks, and notes there are cheaper accommodation options in the area, but the beach itself is not good for swimming or snorkeling.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: Chalok Bay is a great place to grab some food or enjoy a cold drink.

thingsToKnow: The beach is not suitable for swimming or snorkeling.
There are cheaper accommodation options around the Chalok Bay area.

spots.name: Freedom Beach
spots.description: A beautiful, photogenic little beach on the southwest coast of Koh Tao that the creator describes as a gem and a perfect picnic lunch spot. A paved walkway over the boulders connects it to Chalok Bay. Normally very popular.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: I loved this little gem of a beach — this is a perfect lunch picnic spot for us.

mentions.videoTitle: Why Everyone Loves Koh Tao 🇹🇭 (Copy Our Itinerary – 6 Trips Later)
mentions.quote: The best thing about the John Suwan viewpoint is afterwards you can just do a few steps down to Freedom Beach, which is absolutely stunning.

thingsToKnow: There is a 100 baht entrance fee that includes a hotel pickup and drop-off, a bottle of water, and use of the beach.
A paved walk over the boulders connects Freedom Beach all the way to Chalok Bay.
Very busy – the full car park gives an indication of how crowded it gets.
Snorkels can be rented from shops at the beach.
You have to swim quite far out to reach the good snorkelling area.

spots.name: June Juea Bay
spots.description: A small bay on the southwest of Koh Tao with a reputation as a snorkeling spot, though the creator found very poor visibility and murky water when they visited. The access road is not fully paved and slightly steep.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: When we jumped in the water, the visibility was really bad and the water was murky.

thingsToKnow: The road to June Juea Bay is not paved all the way and is slightly steep.
The creator experienced very poor visibility and murky water during their visit.

spots.name: Sai Nuan Beach
spots.description: A cool, hippie-vibe spot on the southwest coast made up of a series of three small, photogenic beaches surrounded by big boulders. The creator recommends it for photography and notes snorkeling should also be good around the rocks.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: This is such a cool, hippie place — another photogenic beach, surrounded by big boulders.

thingsToKnow: There are three small beaches here; you can walk over or around the boulders to see them all.
Bungalows around Sai Nuan Beach are recommended for a more bohemian accommodation experience.

spots.name: Mae Haad Bay
spots.description: The main pier and town area of Koh Tao where the ferry arrives. The creator describes it as a beautiful area with boats coming and going all day, and notes that several major diving and snorkeling company offices are located nearby.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: This is where you will arrive on Koh Tao with the ferry — this is a beautiful area.

thingsToKnow: This is the main ferry arrival point for Koh Tao.
There are cheaper accommodation options in town around the pier.

spots.name: Japanese Gardens
spots.description: The creator's hands-down favorite snorkeling spot on Koh Tao, located near Koh Nang Yuan. It can be reached independently by taxi boat from Sairee Beach (paying the Koh Nang Yuan park entrance fee) or as a highlight stop on a full-day snorkeling trip.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: This is, hands down, my favorite snorkeling spot on Koh Tao.

thingsToKnow: Many taxi boats on Sairee Beach will take you to Koh Nang Yuan to access the Japanese Gardens.
A small park entrance fee is required to access Koh Nang Yuan.
The Japanese Gardens are also a stop on the organized full-day snorkeling trip around Koh Tao.

spots.name: InTouch Resort
spots.description: A resort on Sairee Beach where the creator stayed and highly recommends. It has a charming little restaurant right on the beach and is described as a very relaxing and romantic place.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: I stayed at the InTouch resort and absolutely loved it — their little restaurant on the beach is charming, it's a very relaxing and romantic place.

spots.name: P.Oy's
spots.description: One of the creator's two favorite restaurants on Koh Tao, mentioned as a top dining recommendation alongside The Treehouse Café.

mentions.videoTitle: Where to Go on Koh Tao, Thailand (2026 detailed travel guide) 🐠🌴😊
mentions.quote: My favorite places are P.Oy's and the Tree House.

spots.name: Cozy Hostel
spots.description: A hostel the creator discovered on a morning run and booked for her final 10 days on the island. She specifically sought it out because it bridges the gap between loud party hostels and isolating private Airbnbs, with a common area for meeting people without being overcrowded or dirty.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao Travel Guide (Pt 1) | Where to Stay & Solo Travel Tips
mentions.quote: By some miracle, I actually found one that fits this criteria on this island. It's called Cozy Hostel.

thingsToKnow: Book initial accommodation for only three or four nights so you can explore the island and check hostels in person before committing to a longer stay.
What you see online may be totally different from the reality when you arrive in person.
You do not need to panic-book your entire trip — availability is generally not hard to find on Koh Tao.

spots.name: Koh Tao Muay Thai
spots.description: A Muay Thai gym on Koh Tao that the creator trained at for most of her trip and highly recommends. She did both group classes and private one-on-one sessions and praised every trainer, including fighter Kha.

mentions.videoTitle: Koh Tao Travel Guide (Pt 1) | Where to Stay & Solo Travel Tips
mentions.quote: If you are coming to Koh Tao, you must train at Koh Tao Muay Thai — every single trainer is so amazing and it was so much fun.

thingsToKnow: Private one-on-one sessions are significantly more tiring than group sessions.
Group classes are heavily male-dominated — women visiting alone should be prepared for that.
A package of 8 group classes and 3 private lessons was priced at 4,500 baht (~200 CAD / ~16 CAD per class) at time of visit.
The gym is in the main part of the island; if you stay far south (Moo 3), it can be a 50-minute walk each way.

spots.name: Haad Tien Resort
spots.description: A resort on the east coast of Koh Tao directly connected to Shark Bay (Thian Og Bay), giving guests convenient doorstep access to the beach and snorkeling. Organizes its own snorkeling day trips including visits to Ao Leuk and Hin Wong Bay. A scooter hire spot is only a 10-minute walk away.

mentions.videoTitle: TOP 5 THINGS TO DO in KOH TAO
mentions.quote: the hard Tien Resort which is where we were staying... actually connected to sharks Bay so we were fortunate enough to have that on our doorstep

thingsToKnow: Guests get free beach access to Shark Bay; day visitors must pay an entry fee.
A scooter rental shop is only a 10-minute walk from the resort.
Resort organizes snorkeling excursions to top spots around the island.

spots.name: Sunset Viewpoint
spots.description: A popular viewpoint on the western side of Koh Tao best experienced at sunset, with hammocks to relax in and drinks available for purchase on site. The creator visited during the day and still found it beautiful.

mentions.videoTitle: TOP 5 THINGS TO DO in KOH TAO
mentions.quote: Sunset Viewpoint understandably is probably better to see the sunset and go during sunset time but it was equally as beautiful during the day when we went there

thingsToKnow: Hammocks available to relax in on site.
Drinks including beer available for purchase.
Best visited during sunset for the intended experience.

spots.name: High Rock Viewpoint
spots.description: A viewpoint with a treehouse structure sitting at a higher elevation than Sunset Viewpoint, which the creator considers slightly more beautiful as a result. Entry costs 50 baht and includes one complimentary drink.

mentions.videoTitle: TOP 5 THINGS TO DO in KOH TAO
mentions.quote: there's like a treehouse that the guys that run it have built there it's only 50 bar and with that you get a drink

thingsToKnow: Entry is 50 baht and includes one free drink (water, Coke, etc.).
Slightly higher elevation than Sunset Viewpoint — requires navigating a steeper road.

spots.name: Mango Viewpoint
spots.description: A viewpoint on the same northern route as Sunset and High Rock viewpoints. The creator chose to abort the attempt due to dangerously steep, unpaved, muddy roads that caused serious slipping on a scooter.

mentions.videoTitle: TOP 5 THINGS TO DO in KOH TAO
mentions.quote: there is actually one further third Viewpoint called mango Viewpoint which you can get to on the same route but to be honest we bailed on it just because it had been a little bit wet

thingsToKnow: Extremely dangerous unpaved road — especially hazardous when wet or muddy.
The bike rental shop reported a 70–80% injury rate among visitors attempting this route.
Creator strongly recommends skipping it unless roads are perfectly dry and conditions are ideal.

spots.name: Breeze
spots.description: A restaurant on Sairee Beach serving LA-inspired healthy dishes including wraps and other light meals. The creator visited during the day and enjoyed the food.

mentions.videoTitle: TOP 5 THINGS TO DO in KOH TAO
mentions.quote: we actually cated this great place called Breeze which had some good like sort of La inspired dishes some wraps some like uh just some nice Foods

spots.name: Savage Hostel
spots.description: A hostel right in the middle of Koh Tao with the beach just 10 metres away and an awesome rooftop pool. It offers private rooms as well as social communal spaces, striking a balance between party and chill vibes. Abby and Gaz's brother recommended it and they endorse it for other travellers.

mentions.videoTitle: Why Everyone Loves Koh Tao 🇹🇭 (Copy Our Itinerary – 6 Trips Later)
mentions.quote: It is right in the middle of Koh Tao, the beach is literally 10m that way, it's got this awesome rooftop pool.

thingsToKnow: Has a rooftop pool.
Private rooms are available, not just dorms.
Hosts a free BBQ pool party with burgers, salad, and crisps two or three times a month – guests eat for free.
